{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    n=len(g)
    nz=[any(x!=0 for x in r) for r in g]
    bands=[]; i=0
    while i<n:
        if nz[i]:
            j=i
            while j<n and nz[j]: j+=1
            bands.append((j-i,[r[:] for r in g[i:j]]))
            i=j
        else: i+=1
    # preserve all-zero rows, replacing the nonzero span with bands sorted by height
    if not bands: return g
    start=min(next(i for i,v in enumerate(nz) if v), n)
    end=max(i for i,v in enumerate(nz) if v)+1
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    pos=start
    for _,rows in sorted(bands,key=lambda z:z[0]):
        for r in rows:
            out[pos]=r; pos+=1
    return out"}
